name: verify-mention-queue
description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim @ mention queue and the WebSocket clients it sends to (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code. Use after a change to how @ mentions are queued, flushed, timed out, or dropped, to when a client counts as connected or ready, to how a broadcast reports its writes, or to what a stop does to the queue (lua/claudecode/init.lua send_at_mention, _broadcast_at_mention, queue_mention, schedule_mention_flush, flush_mention_queue, expire_mentions, ms_until_a_
